· Position vs SMA100 ($40,953)/SMA200 ($31,923) — below long-term trends, in weak territory.

· MACD histogram trajectory (-523.5538→188.7557) + improving diagnosis + potential trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $26,424) + band width at 46.68% is relatively wide.

· Swing support ($29,075) + basis (Pivot S1 $22,568, SMA200 $31,923, 5-day low $29,960 based).
· Swing resistance ($30,570) + short-term rebound expected on breakout.
· 5-day high/low pattern ($34,850/$29,960), 20-day high/low pattern ($43,095/$25,055) — Higher Low pattern forming.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.62x) + decreased reliability of movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) + enter long on $30,570 breakout, observe shorting on $29,075 break.
